registration_note: Designed after reviewing V3 historical results. All historical folds are development-only; no claim of a new independent holdout.
selection: raw one-session validation MAE only; no test-based seed or checkpoint selection
architecture: LSTM32 plus last-observation skip, Dense32, separate 1/5 return heads and 3-class direction head
ablation: Optional regression_only variant has direction loss weight 0; register output separately and do not choose a winner using outer test.
limitations: Current source universe is not point-in-time
Adjusted-price and price-unit status remain UNKNOWN unless source evidence verifies them
No headline accuracy threshold or baseline gate was relaxed to force a pass
